selection_status: Selected submission focus: the approximately one-second host/sparse solution (53f38d3), as requested. Selection does not override recorded validation results.

candidates.title: One-second solution · host / sparse
candidates.summary: Selected performance candidate. Grid first-run timing is approximately one second; aLIGO is approximately 0.63 seconds. Exact benchmark reports, repeat runs, logs and code changes are below. Official benchmark checks passed; strict numerical differences and broader gradient diagnostics remain recorded separately.

concepts.title: Build static setup arrays on the host
concepts.before: Small setup operations used JAX array construction and eager kernels.
concepts.after: NumPy builds concrete setup values and index arrays before conversion to JAX, reducing setup dispatch and compilation.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Specialize component evaluation by type
concepts.before: A batched dynamic switch selected each component function.
concepts.after: Group rows by their known component function and preserve an output permutation. Each group evaluates only its own function.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Remove derivatives of constant inputs
concepts.before: Dense component input vectors carried tangent entries even for constant slots.
concepts.after: Static masks identify optimized or linked inputs. Separate scalar slots and stop_gradient remove derivative terms whose true derivatives are zero; lower-sideband variants preserve these scalar slots.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Represent and solve structural sparsity
concepts.before: Dense matrices represented mostly unoccupied optical-system entries.
concepts.after: Build structural CSC patterns and solve with SciPy SuperLU through callbacks. Strict numerical differences must be assessed separately from official checks.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Evaluate component arithmetic on the host
concepts.before: XLA compiled the component bodies and their derivatives.
concepts.after: NumPy component evaluation and a custom JVP move this arithmetic to the host.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Fuse the optical pass behind a custom reverse derivative
concepts.before: Carrier, signal and noise operations were traced as a large JAX computation.
concepts.after: A host plan evaluates the forward pass with an explicit reverse pass behind a custom VJP. Broader transformation support and diagnostic failures remain separate evidence.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Reuse signal factors within a forward/backward evaluation
concepts.before: Solving each right-hand side separately can repeat the same signal-system factorization.
concepts.after: Factor each signal matrix once, solve signal and noise right-hand sides together, and retain digest-checked factors for the matching reverse pass. Every new forward evaluation factors afresh.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Avoid importing the full sparse solver package on the fast path
concepts.before: Importing the public scipy.sparse.linalg package also loads unused solver infrastructure.
concepts.after: Load the SuperLU extension directly for factorization, with a fallback to the public SciPy path. NumPy implements the sparse products used for refinement.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Reduce compiler optimization for small residual programs
concepts.before: Default XLA optimization was applied to the remaining small callback/readout programs.
concepts.after: Package defaults request optimization level 0 and disable CPU fusion emitters before backend initialization, respecting existing flags. This process-wide setting is visible in the source diff.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

candidates.title: Dense JAX · pruning and narrow checkpointing
candidates.summary: Transfer-tested candidate with Grid and aLIGO official and saved-array passes. Final selection has not been recorded.

concepts.title: Build static setup arrays on the host
concepts.before: Small setup operations used JAX array construction and eager kernels.
concepts.after: NumPy builds concrete setup values and index arrays before conversion to JAX, reducing setup dispatch and compilation.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Remove derivatives of constant inputs
concepts.before: Dense component input vectors carried tangent entries even for constant slots.
concepts.after: Static masks identify optimized or linked inputs. Separate scalar slots and stop_gradient remove derivative terms whose true derivatives are zero; lower-sideband variants preserve these scalar slots.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Split constant rows from differentiable rows
concepts.before: A group-level active slot made the same slot active for every row.
concepts.after: Stable row partitions evaluate fully constant rows with all tangents stopped, then restore the original output order. The recorded parent trial was within timing noise.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Checkpoint only component arithmetic
concepts.before: Saving component linearization residuals enlarged the forward program; checkpointing the whole assembly shifted work to backward compilation.
concepts.after: Recompute component values during reverse mode while retaining integer indexing results. Dense scatter and solves stay outside this checkpoint.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Bound assembly by frequency
concepts.before: All frequency rows were assembled as one large vectorized program.
concepts.after: Use one-row assembly chunks while retaining full-vectorized solves. All 101 frequencies are still evaluated.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.

concepts.title: Reuse invariant noise assembly and signal factors
concepts.before: Repeated rows assembled identical noise matrices and signal solves could refactor the same coefficient matrix.
concepts.after: A builder proof enables noise-row reuse; the direct_implicit path shares the signal LU and keeps an explicit conjugate-transposed noise solve.
concepts.attribution: Source mechanism; no isolated per-line timing measurement.
